A semi-literal English rendering of Liebermann’s German, made for this database in 2026 with Claude, a large language model (LLM) made by Anthropic. It is a crib to help the reader with Liebermann’s German, not a separate translation

div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 434 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page); Liebermann’s heading: [II. aus Südenglischen Pontificalien 14. und 15. Jhs.]; Liebermann prints in larger type (the readings of MS Ti, his note b on p. 432): in | aliquem sacrilegum facienda; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “Frankish, before 910; in England before 1350 (Liebermann)”, now “Frankish, before 910; in England before 1350 (Liebermann, I p. 434)”)

note.seg: In England wahrscheinlich nach 1066 eingeführt (da frühe Hss. dort fehlen), aber bei Regino (nicht unmittelbar) hinter I. Aus Reg bei Baluze 668; Rozière 680.
Probably introduced into England after 1066 (since early MSS of it are lacking there), but found in Regino (not immediately) after I. From Reg in Baluze 668; Rozière 680.

Hss.: Cn (Cambridge Corpus 79, gehörte B. Clifford von London, † 1421); Et (‘Liber pontif. of Edm. Lacy, bishop of Exeter [† 1455], a ms. of the 14. cent.’ ed. Barnes p. 287; vgl. o. S. 430{a}); Mm (Cambridge Univ. Mm III 21 f. 282 b, ‘Pontif. Joh. Russel ep. Lincoln. [† 1494]’); ‘Pontifical of Sarum’, Ende 15. Jhs., ed. Maskell Monum. rit. eccl. Angl. II 338; vgl. CLXXX; I 3). Herr A. Rogers copirte mir Cn Mm. ¶ Burchard XI 5 und, ‘Ex conc. Aurel.’ citirend, Coll. 12 part. X 235 folgen Regino; Ivo Decr. XIV 79 folgt Burchard; WASSERSCHLEBEN Regino p. 374.

MSS: Cn (Cambridge Corpus 79, belonged to Bishop Clifford of London, † 1421); Et (‘Liber pontif. of Edm. Lacy, bishop of Exeter [† 1455], a ms. of the 14. cent.’ ed. Barnes p. 287; cf. above p. 430{a}); Mm (Cambridge Univ. Mm III 21 f. 282 b, ‘Pontif. Joh. Russel ep. Lincoln. [† 1494]’); ‘Pontifical of Sarum’, end of the 15. cent., ed. Maskell Monum. rit. eccl. Angl. II 338; cf. CLXXX; I 3). Mr A. Rogers copied Cn Mm for me. ¶ Burchard XI 5 and Coll. 12 part. X 235, citing ‘Ex conc. Aurel.’, follow Regino; Ivo Decr. XIV 79 follows Burchard; WASSERSCHLEBEN Regino p. 374.
